title: governed_record.disposal_authorized event payload (v1)
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Produced by epd2_compliance_service.events. Minimum payload only: identifiers, enum values, timestamps and reason codes. It never carries a document or its bytes, a ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference, an authentication secret, an identity/eID/KYC attribute, a free-text case narrative, or the name of any natural person (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Signals that the separate destruction-authorization step completed. It carries the policy and record versions the authorization is bound to, so a consumer can tell when a later supersession has made it stale.
